plan.title: Closed RFQ Empty Evaluation Time Validation

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on its Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Use the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Apply the required evaluation-reopen permission configuration.
Open the RFQ Settings action that launches the Edit Evaluation Time window.
Confirm the requested evaluation-time dialog opened.
Clear the evaluation ending time field.
Submit the dialog with both required fields empty.
Assert that Procol refuses the empty evaluation-time submission and shows an error.
